sloka: किमर्थं नौ नरव्याघ्र न रोचिष्यति राघव ।विभीषणेन यच्चोक्तमस्मिन् काले सुखावहम् ।। ६.१९.४१ ।।।।
transliteration: kimarthaṁ nau naravyāghra na rociṣyati rāghava ।vibhīṣaṇena yaccoktamasmin kāle sukhāvaham ।। 6.19.41 ।।।।

translations.english: "Valiant Vibheeshana's words are true. Let us proceed and let us not waste time. Let us request Sagara to help the army to be able to proceed to Lanka ruled by Ravana (Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama)."
